feeds.title: NLP School Blog
feeds.description: Blog offers a variety of current content from some of the industry's leading thinkers. Key topics covered are dysfunctional relationships, business and leadership, NLP in practice, NLPU certified master practitioner, transactional analysis, productivity, mindfulness, and more.

feeds.title: NLP Coaching Blog
feeds.description: Key topics covered are Neuro-Linguistic Programming, Time Line Therapy, Hypnosis and NLP Coaching. The Tad James Co provides energizing support for individual advancement both in your personal life and professional careers. Help you discover goals, strategies and opportunities to become a successful, compelling and transformational individual.

feeds.title: Transform Destiny
feeds.description: A blog is full of information on the use of Neuro-Linguistic Programming (known commonly as NLP) in therapy, coaching, sales, marketing, relationships, and everyday life. Transform Destiny offers premium NLP training, events, and online courses.

feeds.title: Inspire 360
feeds.description: Featuring NLP articles written by great NLP Trainers such as Ewan Mochrie, Natalie Debrabandere, and Colin Brown. Inspire 360 provides NLP training, coaching, and personal development, working nationally and internationally with clients to achieve excellent results.

feeds.title: NLP Coaching Academy
feeds.description: If you are interested to know about NLP to increase your NLP knowledge, then the NLP Coaching Academy Blog is for you. NLP Coaching Academy is a premier NLP training and Life coaching organization based out of Bangalore, India.

feeds.title: NLP Training World
feeds.description: NLP Training World is an enthusiastic initiative founded by an even more enthusiastic personality, Mohammed Rafi. We give you reasons on why to attend NLP workshops and why to learn NLP for a better life not only yours and to the world around you.

feeds.title: The NLP Center of New York
feeds.description: Blog & resources on NLP and Hypnosis training for the NLP Center of New York. The NLP Center of New York has been one of the world's leading Neuro-Linguistic Programming and Hypnosis training and coaching organizations. The mission of The NLP Center of New York is to identify limiting patterns of thinking, feeling, and behaving in ourselves and others and to generate more effective and more satisfying alternatives.

feeds.title: NLP Sure
feeds.description: In this blog, you will find everything you need to know about NLP. Key topics covered are NLP techniques, NLP products, book reviews, NLP calibration, NLP strategy, and more. Blog by Mehul Surati a Licensed NLP Practitioner who loves learning NLP and other self-help concepts.

feeds.title: NLP is Fun
feeds.description: NLP Tips and Lessons about Neuro-Linguistic Programming written by Nadia Harper. Nadia is an International NLP Trainer, NLP Coach, Conscious Coach, and Consultant of Personal and Professional Development.

feeds.title: Global NLP Training
feeds.description: Global NLP Training offers NLP Training, Life Coaching Certification, and various other coach training & certification. They connect coaches and NLP enthusiasts around the world in a community, providing post-course follow-up and support.

feeds.title: Excellence Assured
feeds.description: Features NLP (Neuro-Linguistic programming), NLP Coaching, NLP Frame, NLP Language Patterns, NLP Modelling, NLP Online, NLP Techniques, NLP Training, Mind Management, and Business NLP. Excellence Assured provides NLP Training, Trading training and resources, and Coaching Services in the UK and Internationally online.
